fieldValues.title: How does setting up a domain become one affirmation instead of fourteen acts?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Between a story and the first buildable issue the handbook asks the owner for up to fourteen acts. The walks #89 and #90 show agents finishing in days and the owner step staying open for weeks, partly as bookkeeping. The owner has already ruled the direction: confidence grades care, it does not gate (9d50126b); affirm the story, not each record. What is not decided is which acts carry judgement that only the owner can give, and which are rule or group work.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Status quo: the owner affirms each record (domain, personas, clusters, problems, tensions with poles, axes, remedy) one by one in the control room. Leads to: full provenance per record; 247 pending, the axis layer stalls, sessions at rubber-stamp speed.
- Affirm the walk as one act: a domain container with its personas, problems, remedy and axes is read as one story and affirmed once; the records inside are affirmed by derivation. Leads to: one judgement per domain; needs a readable rendering of the walk and a rule that derivation carries affirmation (confidence thread, 45883ea7).
- Delegate to a chartered group: the owner ratifies the group's charter and mandate (clerk#142, a8bc55ef); the group affirms within its domain and reports; the owner affirms only what the report escalates. Leads to: the owner acts at the charter level only; depends on groups having a compass of their own (49f2d00c) and on reports being read (see the reports exercise).
- Nothing gates: suggestions are usable at once, affirmation is a later tip where it is worth it, care mode decides the checks. Leads to: zero setup cost; confidence must be computed and shown, which is not built.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which acts, of the fourteen, has the owner ever changed on review rather than passed? (Count edits and set-asides against affirmations: 4 set aside of 343.) How many affirmed records were later cited by an issue's Answers line or a claim? If a walk affirmed as one story produced the same issues as the one-by-one walk, the per-record acts were bookkeeping. The decided moves in 45883ea7 and decision 77e04b19's revisit (around 2026-11-21) are the natural point to choose.
fieldValues.next_action: Measure the four cases on #89: acts the owner edited vs passed; records cited later. Draft the "affirm the walk" rendering as a composition over the domain container and try it on #90 before proposing a decision.
